page_title: FUL 1-0 LUT | Fulham v Luton 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Tom Lockyer (Luton) reacts quickest to a cross from Issa Kabore, but slams his header well wide of the left post from around the penalty spot.
90+1' Substitution. Willian makes his way off the pitch and Calvin Bassey (Fulham) comes on as his replacement.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
87' Lovely run from Carlos Vinicius (Fulham). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
85' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
83' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) is penalised for a foul. Michael Salisbury had a clear view and blows his whistle.
83' Alfie Doughty (Luton) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
82' Issa Kabore (Luton) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. Luton force a corner. They send men into the box.
81' Today's match ends for Reece Burke who will be replaced by Cauley Woodrow (Luton).
81' We are about to witness a subsitution. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) for Harry Wilson.
81' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Andreas Pereira is replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
79' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
77' The Luton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) is replacing Albert Sambi Lokonga.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tahith Chong trots off the pitch and is replaced by Elijah Adebayo (Luton).
74' Substitution. Carlton Morris leaves the pitch and is replaced by Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton).
74' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alfie Doughty (Luton) replacing Jacob Brown.
73' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

73' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The referee blows his whistle, Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
72' Tim Ream (Fulham) whips the ball into the box and Timothy Castagne takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
69' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes it short.

68' Chance! Willian (Fulham) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Andreas Pereira, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
65' 1 - 0 Goal! 1:0. The ball rebounds to Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
63' Here is a change. Raul Jimenez is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Carlos Vinicius (Fulham).
63' Substitution. Alex Iwobi (Fulham) replaces Harrison Reed.
61' Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) commits a rough challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Fulham, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
60' Kenny Tete (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Thomas Kaminski comes off his line to gather the ball.

59' Kenny Tete (Fulham) rises high to meet a perfect corner kick and sends in a long-range header from the edge of the box. The effort goes straight at the goalkeeper's gloves, causing him little trouble.
59' The referee awards a corner and Andreas Pereira (Fulham) goes over to take it.
58' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Fulham earn a corner.

52' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
52' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
49' Amari'i Bell (Luton) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
47' Tim Ream (Fulham) tries to find Andreas Pereira, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Carlton Morris (Luton) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Issa Diop (Fulham) receives a yellow card for infringement.

44' Carlton Morris (Luton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Salisbury no option but to blow his whistle. Fulham win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
42' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
41' Issa Kabore (Luton) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
40' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.

39' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Michael Salisbury with no other option than to blow for a foul. Luton have a free kick.
37' Thomas Kaminski (Luton) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.

37' Close! Harry Wilson (Fulham) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
33' Issa Kabore (Luton) commits a foul during an attacking move.
32' Harrison Reed (Fulham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
31' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
30' Fulham are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this. Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) makes a strong challenge and Michael Salisbury blows for a foul.
27' Tahith Chong (Luton) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.

27' Post! Jacob Brown (Luton) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the centre of the box wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the right post!

26' Carlton Morris (Luton) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
25' Jacob Brown (Luton) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
23' Harry Wilson (Fulham) takes the free kick but it's straight at the goalkeeper.
22' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton) commits a rough challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for an infringement. Fulham are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.

20' Kenny Tete (Fulham) finds space in the box and tries a looping header at goal from the corner, but the ball goes just over the bar. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
20' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

20' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kenny Tete (Fulham), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
18' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) attempts to feed Raul Jimenez with a chip pass, but Thomas Kaminski reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.
12' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
12' An attempted cross from Kenny Tete (Fulham) is cleared.
10' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
9' Wonderful movement by Fulham. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
6' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
6' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Timothy Castagne (Fulham). The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fulham.

5' Tahith Chong (Luton) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Bernd Leno.
4' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
4' Issa Kabore (Luton) makes a rough challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul. Fulham will take a free kick near the side line.
2' Reece Burke (Luton) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Luton will have the kick-off.
Michael Salisbury is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
